text:
molly: Quick sync: proposing 'slate gating' for model onboarding — combine lightweight smokebench, a golden-input run, and an incremental runtime canary. Short doc in thread. Thoughts?

arjun: Love the name. What's the main difference from current 'smokehouse + canary' flow?

molly: Main diffs: 1) single gate config per slate (model bundle) 2) timeboxed runtime canary with traffic shaping 3) explicit failure modes -> fallback mapping. Aim: fewer back-and-forths on thresholds.

kevin: Concern: does the slate gate add latency to ingest? We have tight SLAs for onboarding speed.

emily: If we keep smokebench < 5m and golden run quick, shouldn't be big. We can run smokebench on queued reserved runners.

molly: Proposed config (YAML):
```yaml
slate_gate:
  smoke_timeout: 300
  golden_checks: [token_quality, perplexity_delta]
  canary_window: 1800
  canary_fraction: 0.05
  fallback_chain: [quantized-compat, small-ensemble, cached-response]
```

sam: Two questions: (1) metric set for golden_checks? (2) who owns fallback_chain mapping?

arjun: Metric proposal: embed_cosine >= 0.92, ppl_delta <= 1.2, latency_p50 <= baseline*1.4. Might need model-specific baselines.

kevin: What about dataset drift? golden inputs can be gamed. Need randomized seeding and synthetic edge cases.

molly: Agree. Plan: golden set = core golden + 10 randomized perturbations + 5 adversarial examples from probe bank. Seeded via provenance tracking.

ci-bot: pipeline: slate gate job queued on runners-qa. Smokebench k8s job id: job-98321.

emily: :thumbsup: on provenance tracking. Can we auto-generate fallback tickets when slate gate fails?

sam: Yes — push to ops queue with failure labels (metric, cause). Add automatic rollbacks for canary > failure threshold.

molly: Action items:
- arjun: write metric registry page for slate gates (due EOD Thu)
- emily: update prober to add randomized perturbations
- kevin: estimate added infra cost for reserved runners
- sam: sketch rollback playbook

If no objections, I'll merge gate config RFC branch tomorrow.

kevin: :+1: Merge after CI green. Please include a note about chargeback to model owners.

arjun: One more: logging schema needs a 'slate_id' and 'gate_phase' fields. Otherwise tracing is painful.

molly: Noted. I'll add schema PR.

emily: thanks all, will follow up on prober PR.
